blocker_pdf_vectors: Plan pages contain essentially no wall vector paths (UI fills only). Floor plans are embedded rasters (NAGA marketing boards).
method_summary: Crop per-floor panels from embedded boards → strip branding → contour-trace walls to SVG → colored presentation PNG (native + Lanczos long-edge 7680) → overlay vs brochure page clips.

long7680_meta.warning: Upscale does not add architectural detail; pixels interpolated from source raster.

method.geometry: cropped from brochure-embedded NAGA marketing plan board raster (not PDF vector walls — those absent)
method.vectors: OpenCV contour trace of dark wall poché from board raster
method.presentation: branding-stripped colored board panel on white surround; source colors retained
method.not_done: No invented dimension chains/north/scale; no watermark copy; no generative redraw

assets.uncertainty: Board vs brochure page framing/furniture styling differ; wall mask may include some dark furniture/cars; text on board may be partially illegible at native res.

limitations_extra: SVG wall traces are contour extractions from board rasters — may include dark furniture/cars; not clean architectural layer separation.
Native presentation resolution is board-panel limited (~670–870 px wide); 7680 long-edge files are Lanczos upscales without new detail.
Overlay |diff| vs brochure page clips is elevated because board panel vs brochure marketing framing/furniture differ; use overlay for QC not pixel identity.
Equal-third panel crops may clip edge labels on some boards.
